CONTRIBUTING.md:224: ### 2d. Address findings and re-push (the WIP subsection at line 237 lives under it)
No assertion binds the pointer target ('§2d') to an existing CONTRIBUTING.md section heading, so the two are free to drift apart.
advisory.finding: test_agents_does_not_restate_the_rationale_paragraph asserts the exact heading string "Why the ticket comment isn't enough" is absent from AGENTS.md. This is a wording change-detector: rephrasing the CONTRIBUTING.md heading (a behavior-preserving edit, read only by humans/LLMs — not a non-human consumer that branches on the exact value) would make the negative assertion vacuously pass or, if the same phrase were reused verbatim as a legitimate one-line pointer, break with no observable regression.
merged_from: AGENTS.md and the packaged guide both cross-reference CONTRIBUTING.md "§2d" (test_agents_carries_the_pointer asserts the literal "[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) §2d"), but no test asserts CONTRIBUTING.md actually still exposes a §2d section/anchor. If section 2d is renumbered or the WIP subsection moves, the pointers rot silently and the suite stays green — a regression the diff's cross-surface-consistency goal directly targets.
